text:
Leah Rivera: Heads-up: multiple mid-market trials asked for a lighter "onramp bundle" — low-commit starter, modest reserved Scale, and an easy convert path. Key asks: per-route ceilings, documented "surge credits", and a priority-lane option for predictable latency. Want to scope MVP and launch checks. Quick sketch: Starter (small commit + 1k qps cap), Scale (bigger commit + soft per-route caps), Priority lane add-on (manual purchase). Thoughts? :spiral_calendar:

Owen Park: From infra perspective: per-route ceilings are cheap if they're soft limits (alerts + throttles). Hard guarantees need reserved capacity and admission control (separate queue). Priority lane = extra queue + weighted fairshare. Rough: 2 devs 3 sprints to get safe rollout + e2e tests + canary.

Priya Desai: Pricing POV: we should sell Starter as monthly commit with lower token price, Scale as 3/6/12 mo commit tiers. Priority lane priced as credits or % uplift. Surge credits: include small monthly buffer (e.g., 20% of commit) and paid top-ups. Need conversion window: 30 days seems standard.

Tom Brooks: Sales feedback: customers want a per-route cap they can set to stop embed-heavy endpoints from blowing budgets. Also want a self-serve button to convert trial to commit. If console flow is smooth, conversion rates go way up.

quota-bot: Current route quota sample:

```
{
  "route_id": "embed-service",
  "daily_token_quota": 50000,
  "soft_limit": true,
  "on_exceed": "notify_owner",
  "surge_buffer": 10000
}
```

Also: priority-lane toggle exists but needs billing hook.

Owen Park: Implementation notes: to avoid double-billing when migrating to reserved pool, we need a short reconciliation window and a flag on invoices. DB: commitments table + route_attachment table. Console: 1 new modal + api endpoint POST /commitments/attach-route. Ops: migration runbook + rollback.

Leah Rivera: Proposed MVP launch criteria: 1) Console + API to set per-route soft caps and view telemetry; 2) SKU definitions for Starter/Scale with clear commit amounts and surge buffer policy; 3) Manual purchase flow for Priority lane (billing integration later); 4) Contract language for 30-day conversion + described surge credits; 5) Runbook, docs, and 1-2 canary customers.

Priya Desai: Add KPIs: conversion rate >= 25% on pilot, <1% incidents caused by cap enforcement, and average latency improvement for priority lane customers >10ms. Also list package SKUs in draft PR.

Tom Brooks: Can we allow customers to set per-route hard ceilings that auto-block traffic? Some will demand it. For MVP prefer soft caps + explicit opt-in hard block in Q+1.

Leah Rivera: Action items:
- Owen: detailed tech scope + risk list (EOD Thu)
- Priya: SKU + price matrix + draft contract clause (Mon)
- Tom: pilot customer shortlist + sales playbook bullets (Fri)
- @quota-bot: attach recent usage export for 3 pilot accounts
We will decision-sync next Tue. Thanks all :rocket:
